description: Optional integration examples using public U.S. ArcGIS services.

checks.name: Census grouped server statistics
checks.sql: SELECT group_value, statistic_value FROM arcgis.main.arcgis_statistics('https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/State_County/MapServer/1', 'OBJECTID', statistic := 'count', group_by := 'STATE', where_clause := 'STATE = ''36''') ORDER BY group_value

checks.name: NOAA stations and geometry
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), bool_and(stationname IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL) FROM (SELECT stationname, geometry FROM arcgis.main.arcgis_query('https://mapservices.weather.noaa.gov/vector/rest/services/obs/surface_obs/MapServer/10') LIMIT 3)

checks.name: FEMA spatial feature query
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) > 0, bool_and(FLD_ZONE IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL) FROM (SELECT FLD_ZONE, geometry FROM arcgis.main.arcgis_query('https://hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28') WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-77.05,38.85,-77.04,38.86)) LIMIT 3)

checks.name: FEMA server count by bounding box
USGS elevation sampling
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), bool_and(TRY_CAST(value AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 0 AND 100) FROM arcgis.main.arcgis_sample('https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer', '[[-77.0365,38.8977],[-77.04,38.90]]')
